mint.order: sequential per wallet: Pointer -> Ember -> Verdant -> Frost -> Void
mint.sold_out_note: If Pointer is sold out, no new wallet can start minting.
steps: Check Binance Agent ID: balanceOf(wallet) >= 1 on 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
Call nextMintQuote(wallet) for the exact price
Call mint() payable with exactly that amount (underpay and overpay revert)
Repeat for the next piece until the set of 5 is complete

staking.reward: BNB from the pool (no reward token)
staking.rules: Stake a complete set of 5 pieces (one of each: Pointer, Ember, Verdant, Frost, Void). The 5 NFTs lock in the staking contract; unstake() returns them and pays pending rewards.
staking.daily_release: 10% of remaining pool per day, split equally among staked sets (DAILY_RELEASE_BPS=1000). Rewards only accrue while at least one set is staked; idle days are never paid retroactively.
staking.pool_funding: Manual: owner funds the pool from mint revenue via fundPool(). No automatic split from mint fees. No owner withdraw of the pool — it only leaves via claim()/unstake() by stakers.
